title: Synthetic Data Lakehouse
summary: A production-grade e-commerce data lakehouse demo that ingests Kaggle/OpenAPI data through a Bronze-Silver-Gold PySpark/Databricks medallion pipeline and validates quality with a self-hosted Ollama LLM. It generates privacy-safe synthetic data by running SDV's CTGAN, GaussianCopula, TVAE and HMA synthesizers (with SDV's evaluate_quality/run_diagnostic) directly via the sdv package's single_table, multi_table and evaluation APIs.
evidence: pipeline/synthetic_gen.py:21-101 imports SDV's SingleTableMetadata, GaussianCopulaSynthesizer, CTGANSynthesizer and calls .fit()/.sample()
